newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer - Mark level reflects fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer - Mark level reflects fundamentals.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that the mark's current level on currency markets reflected fundamentals but that the Bundesbank was not interested in the mark weakening further.
"We see that the mark's level on the foreign exchanges all in all mirrors the fundamentals fairly correctly," Tietmeyer said.
He also said that the Bundesbank was not interested in a further weakening of the mark,
"We are not interested in a weak mark. We continue to be interested in having a strong mark."
He added that in this issue the Bundesbank's view conformed with that held in the U.S.
Tietmeyer was speaking at a news conference following a regular policy-setting council meeting.
